note:
1513 -> 1497, measured with the CI command (`npx tsc --project tsconfig.json
--noEmit`) at HEAD with no uncommitted work in the tree.

Thirteen of the sixteen are the field widgets, nine originating there and four
caused downstream by those nine. Seven were one import: res_user_group_ids_field
imported `Record` from @web/model/record, which shadows the built-in utility type
for the whole module, so every `@type {Record<string, any>}` in the file read as
"Type Record is not generic" and documented nothing. Aliasing it to
RecordComponent restored them and surfaced the real shape mismatch underneath --
`categories` is built in two phases, buildCategories returning {id, name,
privilege_ids} and buildFields later attaching `privileges`, while getCategoryArch
demanded the finished shape. Now a PrivilegeCategory/Privilege typedef pair, with
the two-phase build stated where the cast happens. The other two: x2many_field
extractProps destructured the optional `relatedFields` without annotating the
parameter, and properties_field onPropertyMove took `string` where
movePropertyByOffset accepts "up" | "down".

The rest come from the ui and core work -- six `any` casts dropped with the
uncaught-error `event` declaration, two more from
DateTimePickerServiceParams.target, and the JSDoc blocks restored on
pivot_value_utils (an import had been inserted between the annotation and the
function it documented, which makes it inert) and computeWidths.

THE DURABLE FIGURE IS THE DELTA, NOT THE ABSOLUTE. This count is whole-repo, and
CLAUDE.md §13 applies: it read 1502/1503/1505 in consecutive runs on a tree with
43 files open in other sessions. Re-measure in a detached worktree, or with
`git status --porcelain` empty, before concluding anything from it.
